title: Nimble Light Australian Cream Mousse
description: A tangy and light Australian dessert featuring whipping cream, this mousse is perfect for warm evenings. It is also gluten-free friendly and can be served in a fondue pot.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whip the chilled whipping cream until it forms stiff peaks.
In a separate bowl, mix together the lemon juice, sugar, vanilla extract, and salt until the sugar is dissolved.
Fold the lemon mixture into the whipped cream until well combined.
Stir in the chopped brine-dried citrus peel.
Spoon the mousse into a fondue pot or individual serving cups.
Chill the mousse in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Serve the mousse cold, garnished with additional citrus peel if desired.
